Risk_Description: ERP database has no recently tested disaster recovery process
Mitigation: Perform full restore test and validate failover/failback before migration
Contingency: Delay ERP migration and retain source environment
Notes: Production migration blocked until resolved

Risk_Description: Legacy authentication protocols may fail in target architecture
Mitigation: Inventory NTLM LDAP and Kerberos dependencies and modernize authentication
Contingency: Maintain hybrid AD connectivity and rollback to source
Notes: Identity must be tested before cutover

Risk_Description: Application credentials are not centrally managed
Mitigation: Move secrets to Azure Key Vault and rotate credentials
Contingency: Restore prior credentials from secure recovery process
Notes: No plaintext secrets should enter repositories or pipelines

Risk_Description: Persistent administrative privileges increase migration security exposure
Mitigation: Implement MFA PIM JIT and least privilege
Contingency: Disable compromised privileged accounts and use emergency access process
Notes: Administrative access is a migration gate

Risk_Description: Firewall or routing errors may break cross-tier dependencies
Mitigation: Validate network flow matrix routing DNS NSGs and firewall rules
Contingency: Restore previous routes and DNS paths
Notes: Dependency testing required before every wave

Risk_Description: Hybrid DNS failure could make applications unreachable
Mitigation: Implement and test hybrid DNS resolution before migration
Contingency: Revert DNS changes and direct clients to source endpoints
Notes: DNS is a shared dependency

Risk_Description: Some critical workloads have outdated restore tests
Mitigation: Perform restore validation and document recovery times
Contingency: Cancel cutover if backup validation fails
Notes: Backup success alone is not sufficient

Risk_Description: Rollback procedures have not been tested
Mitigation: Create rollback runbooks and conduct rehearsal before cutover
Contingency: Abort production migration until rollback test passes
Notes: Highest priority migration control

Risk_Description: Target-state monitoring may not detect migration failures quickly
Mitigation: Deploy Azure Monitor Log Analytics alerts and dashboards before pilot
Contingency: Use source monitoring platform until target monitoring is verified
Notes: Monitoring must precede production cutover

Risk_Description: Custom application behavior may differ after migration
Mitigation: Perform functional performance and integration testing
Contingency: Rollback affected application to source
Notes: Application owners must provide signoff

Risk_Description: Database target may not meet current performance requirements
Mitigation: Capture baseline metrics and perform load testing on target
Contingency: Resize target or return database workload to source
Notes: Measure latency IOPS CPU and query performance

Risk_Description: VPN bandwidth or latency may be insufficient during coexistence
Mitigation: Perform bandwidth latency packet loss and throughput testing
Contingency: Schedule migrations during low usage or upgrade connectivity
Notes: Hybrid period may last multiple waves

Risk_Description: Expired or incorrect certificates may cause application failure
Mitigation: Create certificate inventory validate expiry chains bindings and DNS names
Contingency: Restore previous certificates and endpoints
Notes: Certificate validation required during pre-check

Risk_Description: Legacy service accounts may have undocumented permissions
Mitigation: Inventory permissions rotate credentials and reduce privileges
Contingency: Re-enable documented source service account during rollback
Notes: Prefer managed identities where supported

Risk_Description: New Azure resources may be deployed without baseline controls
Mitigation: Enable Defender for Cloud Azure Policy RBAC logging and tagging before workload deployment
Contingency: Stop deployment pipeline until security baseline passes
Notes: Landing zone security must precede migration

Risk_Description: Target architecture may not preserve regulatory controls
Mitigation: Map current controls to Azure Policy Purview logging encryption and retention
Contingency: Keep regulated workload on source until compliance validation completes
Notes: Requires compliance owner approval

Risk_Description: Factory edge workload may lose Azure connectivity
Mitigation: Preserve offline processing and test disconnected operation
Contingency: Keep workload running locally on Azure Local
Notes: Latency sensitive workload should remain local

Risk_Description: Application or database writes could diverge during cutover
Mitigation: Define synchronization freeze and reconciliation procedures
Contingency: Rollback using validated recovery point and transaction reconciliation
Notes: Explicit data consistency checks required

Risk_Description: Unapproved changes could disrupt migration schedule
Mitigation: Implement change freeze CAB approval and migration calendar
Contingency: Reschedule affected wave
Notes: Coordinate production changes with migration windows

Risk_Description: Operations team may not be ready to support target platform
Mitigation: Provide runbooks training dashboards escalation paths and operational handoff
Contingency: Extend hypercare period and retain migration engineering support
Notes: Operational readiness required before project closure
